name: rq2-three-arm
description: RQ2 as a design: does the number of source cultures affect resident-culture retention when total migration is held constant? Three mechanisms (null control, homophilous copying, conformist transmission) across K, on matched seeds. All arms share a baseline key and a scenario key, so they face a byte-identical city and byte-identical arrivals -- only the mechanism differs. Pilot P-9 ran a 4-seed version of this and found no K effect under either rule; the replicate count here is set for a mean, NOT for the rate H3 needs, which would take hundreds. Report the null arm alongside the others, report distributions rather than means for the homophily arm (it looks bimodal at K=4), and state the drift regime.
